lines.en: label halloweenfour5:
scene nikotohahalloween1
: It’s not about that, you fucking moron. It’s-
: Wait. Your what?

: I’m organizing an uprising that calls for pants equality between men and women. The fashion industry is attempting to suppress us via the underutilization of pockets. The need for purses ends now, Onee-chan.
: Be careful, Noriko. I made this same mistake when I was your age. You don’t know who you’re messing with right now. This is dangerous.
: I will succeed where you have failed! No representation without compartmentalization!
: Also, why are you calling me? I’m at a party right now.
: I wanted to know if Akira is with you. He hasn’t been answering my texts.
: Hm? He’s here. He’s not really “with” me, though. He’s kind of just doing his rounds and there’s nothing I can do but wait for my turn.
: How about being a little more proactive by going up to him and telling him that his beloved childhood friend would like to have a word?
: A word in regard to what, Onee-chan? If you would like to leave a message, please leave your name, number, a short description of the reason for your call, and the best time to reach you.
: Jennifer Aniston, 9-1-1, the results of his chlamydia test, and 2:34 AM. Thanks.
: It will be done! Goodbye, Onee-chan!
: Wait, Noriko. I really-
scene nikotohahalloween2
: Tch. Fucking bitch. She didn’t even tell Akira I’ve been trying to reach him.
: I...guess he just doesn’t care about the results of his chlamydia test? I’m not really sure what I’m supposed to say here.
scene nikotohahalloween3
: As my protege, you are supposed to simply nod and go along with everything I say or do. Which means you must now also hold a grudge against your teacher until the next time he screws me.
: Which, hopefully, will be tonight as I’ve never had kinky Halloween sex before and I kind of want to do that.
: And this makes me a better singer...how?
: By...uhh...
scene nikotohahalloween4
: Being a singer is kind of like...being a receptionist.
: You need to...think of what your fans and...the doctor...need out of you to...make it a...profession worth...
scene nikotohahalloween5
: Just do what I fucking tell you to, okay?
: I’ll get right on that, Princess Niki.
: See? Was that so hard?
: Cotton candy girl! Explain to me in seven words or less the method in which you command your childspawn!
scene nikotohahalloween6
: Otoha isn’t my childspawn. She’s just a clueless teenager I took under my wing because I’m a genius who can see the promise within her.
: So it is your job to provide the clues that will turn her into a life-detective?
: Yeah, exactly.
: Are we really sure “exactly” is the word we were supposed to use there?
: Why do you ask, Kaori? The miniature police-woman who’s been pacing back and forth all night isn’t actually your kid is she? You look too young. New employee maybe?
scene nikotohahalloween7
: Nao-chan is no employee! Nor is she a child!
: She is a mug monster who subsists primarily on her chosen diet of sugary milk soup Wednesday through Saturday and hamburger steak the other four nights of the week.
: One...two...
: Whatever the case, I’m glad you’re not looking for tips on motherhood because I am not the girl you want to ask. I’m never having kids.
scene nikotohahalloween8
: Is it because your chosen mate’s sperms are ineffective? Or do you simply detest the sound of new life’s screams?
: Seven...eight? That’s too many days.
: Shut up, Otoha. The latter. Though I’d prefer the former so I could finally get rid of the birth control alarm on my phone.
: What is the “birth control?”

: You know how when you start to get a cold or whatever you can take, like...zinc tablets to amp up your antibodies to prepare yourself for it? It’s like that. Just the sickness is a child, which is way worse.
: Will feeding this medicine to a child make it disappear?
scene nikotohahalloween9
: Careful, Kaori. I’m pretty sure your childspawn thinks you’re trying to get rid of her.
: Reduce your usage of exclamation points, Nao-chan. I would never get rid of you. I just want to know what to do if a child ever appears inside of my stretchy baby balloon.
: Can we please not call it that?
scene nikotohahalloween10
: Yeah, I don’t think that’s a thing you need to worry about until you start having sex.
: And I would not have worried until recently! But a kiss happened and now I’m worried a sex will happen too!
: You kissed someone? When? Who? I never heard about this.
scene nikotohahalloween11
: During nighttime! It was-
: It was...
: Nao-chan!
scene nikotohahalloween12
: Uhh...I mean...I know you said she’s not a child, but...
: W...What I meant by Nao-chan is...it wasn’t Nao-chan at all! It was...it...uhh...
: A stranger!
scene nikotohahalloween13
: You kissed a stranger so passionately that you think you two are going to fuck now? I didn’t realize you were like that, Kaori. But good for you, I guess.
scene nikotohahalloween14
: But it was not me who did the kissing! It was a me inside of me! A me who wanted to do the kissing while the me-me was on a brain vacation!
: Hey yeah. That’s what happened with me too, Niki. I’m not at fault at all.
: Shush. Kaori, what do you mean it was the “you inside of you?” Are you talking about your, like...conscience or whatever? That little voice that tells you what’s right and wrong?
: There is no little voice. Only a big one. Bigger than a tree in a glass room with special petals you can’t get from anywhere else.
: Uh-huh. Go on.
: I just fear that the baby balloon is in danger of having its stretch function utilized if the not me-me craves a mate in the near future.
: Sorry to jump in again, but aren’t you in your twenties? Because that’s a puberty-thought and you seem a little behind schedule if you’re just getting those now.
: I don’t think that’s what Kaori means. I think she’s just...a little confused about romance and what to expect next. Which, honestly, is pretty damn fair.
scene nikotohahalloween15
: Without beating around the bush, it’s that unexpectedness of love that makes it kind of suck. But, weirdly enough, that’s also what makes it great.
: Now, I’ve never made out with a stranger like you apparently have, but if that stranger is someone you want to spend more time with and neither of you minds that the not you-you wants to kiss...
: I don’t see what the issue is. You like this person, right?
: Yes! They are the only person I like on the kissing level. And a suitable candidate to procreate with should Nao-chan ever want a smaller sister.
: Which she will not want for a long time according to her many dots.
scene nikotohahalloween16
: Then don’t even worry about it, Kaori. All that baby stuff is something that comes way later on in relationships most of the time. And if all you’ve done is kiss, there’s nothing to worry about.
: Besides, focusing on stuff like that just fucks with your head and takes away from all the fun in the honeymoon stage of a relationship.
: H-Honeymoon?! Is the honeyed moon not the one that rises after saying “I am” at a traditional human wedding ceremony?! Does that come before the balloon stretching?!
: No, no — that’s not it. I just mean that when you’re in the earliest stages of liking someone, your brain wants to focus on that and only that.
: You say things you would never say under normal circumstances...do things that seem like good ideas in the moment but-
: Ahem.
scene nikotohahalloween17
: But are actually extremely fucking stupid and will torment you every time you look back on them from that point onward.

: At what stage in my training do I learn the part of singing where I can start pointedly saying things about people I’m with without directly revealing to them that they’re the one I’m talking about?
scene nikotohahalloween18
: That has nothing to do with singing. That’s just part of being a girl.
: Nao-chan! Come with me to the oven-room!
: The not me-me has warned me that an important conversation is about to happen and if we continue to stand here, important vibrations will bounce off of us!
: I think that’s our cue.
scene nikotohahalloween19
: Our cue to what?
: I don’t know...talk maybe?
: About what? Our tribute livestream went pretty well tonight. We could talk about that?
: You know that’s not what I mean.
: Of course I know that. I’m not a fucking moron, Otoha.
: This smile is me giving you chance after chance to change the topic because you’re not going to like literally anything I have to say about this and I want to preserve our current relationship.
scene nikotohahalloween20
: Am I wrong in thinking our “current relationship” is one where we can talk about our feelings and, like...try to resolve them or whatever?
: Yeah. You are. Plus, you already have a relationship like that. And I’d be willing to put money on the fact that you haven’t talked about this with her yet, have you?
: Her? No. I have no idea where I’d even start.
: Would you mind explaining what the emphasis on “her” was for right there? Because that made it sound like you’ve told somebody else and that would be a very, very stupid thing to do, Otoha.
: I told Sensei.
scene nikotohahalloween21
: You did what?!
: N-Not that it was you specifically! Just that I kissed somebody else! I wanted to hear what he thought about it because he’s the king of bad decisions and-
scene nikotohahalloween22
: Otoha, for the love of fucking God, please quash this childish crush of yours before it becomes even more of a burden than it already is. For both of us.
: Do you think I want to feel like this? Hell no. But I do. And you’re the one who literally just said that it’s during times like this where we do stupid shit and...say stupid things.

: Which is why I so kindly dropped the fact that you ever kissed me in the first place. But it’s hard to qualify repeated offenses as impulsive decisions and it’s starting to feel like this is calculated.
: Calculated? What’s that supposed to mean?
scene nikotohahalloween23
: What do you want out of this? What do you expect to happen?
: Do you want me to just...drop the love I’ve held forever and hook up with a high-school girl instead? Do you not realize how ridiculous that sounds?
: Not really. But maybe I’m just jaded and easily influenced by what other influential adults around me seem to do when it comes to high-school girls.
: Watch your fucking mouth, Otoha. I’m not an idiot. I know what you meant by that.
scene nikotohahalloween24
: Niki...when I’m with you, I-
: You what? Get fucking butterflies? Can’t think straight? Imagine a life where the two of us can continue to do our own thing, but hop into one another’s arms whenever we get home?

: And it won’t matter if it’s behind a curtain or anything like that because it can be “just for us” and it “won’t be weird” since “age is only a number” and blah blah blah I’m a horny fucking teenager.
scene nikotohahalloween25
: Do you really think you’re the first teenage girl who’s ever developed “feelings” for me? Because, I hate to break to it to you, Otoha, but this isn’t exactly new.

: Granted, you’re the first who’s ever actually succeeded in kissing me, though. So kudos to you for that, I guess. God forbid I let my guard down for a single fucking second in my own fucking dressing room.
: I’m sorry for that, okay? I got caught up in the mood and-
: Of course you got “caught up in the mood.” My whole job...my whole life has been dedicated to creating that mood for fucking years now. That’s what it means to be an idol.
: You’re supposed to love me and fantasize about me and look up to me because that’s what keeps this industry afloat. And without impulsive, stupid girls like you, it would all come crumbling down.
: But the honest truth is that none of you know the first thing about me and, if you did, you’d realize I’m just as much of a fucking project as anybody else.
: Plus, I’m pretty sure I’m only mentally capable of loving one person for the rest of my life because someone somewhere cursed me or some shit. And, news-flash, that person is definitely not you.
: Nor is it any of the other trillion girls out there who’ve sent me love letters or hung on too long at handshake events or snuck backstage to try and “tell me how they feel.”
: Every single one of you has fallen for the trap laid out by my producers. That’s all this is. It isn’t love. You’re just an idiot.
: Are you done now? Can I say something?
: That depends on what it is you want to say.
: Do you really think I’m the same as everyone else?
: In regard to your feelings for me? Oh yeah. You’re not even remotely different. It’s your talent that separates you from the others.
: But the reason I spend so much time on you has everything to do with that and nothing to do with anything “personal.”
: And you don’t think it’s at all possible that I started feeling this way about you because of all that extra time you spend on me?
scene nikotohahalloween26
: I don’t give a shit why or how you started feeling this way about me. I just know that it puts me in a weird fucking spot and that I don’t think of you that way and that I want it to stop.
: Now, a question for you — do you want to work in this industry at all, Otoha? Or are you only taking lessons from me because you hoped you’d have a shot at my “love?” Which, again, you don’t.
: I...do. Want to work in this industry, I mean. Or...at least I think I do. I’m not really sure yet.
: That’s fine. You don’t need to be sure at your age. Lord knows I wasn’t.
: But you’ve gotta get your head on straight and stop spending all this time thinking about extra shit. You’ve gotta stop thinking about me.
: Stop thinking about everything other than music if you really want to make it. Your personal life is nothing more than a distraction. Hone your skills now, have feelings later.
: Then, once you’re the best, you can start complaining about how love sucks. And you can be the one rejecting the advances of a bunch of teenagers who want you to finger them. The end.
: And now you’re sad. See? I told you this wasn’t a thing you wanted to talk about.
: I know. But I...feel like we kind of had to.
scene nikotohahalloween27
: I still think I’m a little different from everyone else you’re trying to compare me to. But if you’re that against the idea of ever being with me, I won’t bring it up again.
: Maybe you’re right. Maybe all of this personal shit is a distraction and I need to...start ignoring all of that if I really want a shot. Maybe that’s true.
: I just hoped I’d be able to do both. To enjoy my life and work toward the future.
: Well, in my shitty experience, it’s either one or the other. And if that doesn’t align with your core beliefs, maybe you need to find another instructor.
scene nikotohahalloween28
: Well, maybe it’s just the apparently-manufactured desire for you to take my clothes off speaking, but I’m pretty sure it has to be you if I’m going to have a real shot at success.
: You won’t have any shot at all if you keep saying shit like that, Otoha. Believe in yourself and cast aside anyone else who gets in the way. That’s what it takes to make it today.
: That and a lot of heartache.
: If that’s what needs to be done, it will be done.
scene nikotohahalloween29
: I return!
scene nikotohahalloween30
: With another serving of justice.
: And on that note, the swap back into fun Niki begins! Are you going to finish your weiner festival, Otoha?
scene nikotohahalloween31
: Sacrilege! Call the food item by its correct name!
: Nah. I’ve had enough penis party for today. You can have the rest.
scene nikotohahalloween32
: That one is even worse! Your decision to rent my services and building for the day are suddenly very confusing to me if all you are going to do is play games!
scene black
: Ooooh do you have any games? What else can we do around here? I want to do something fun tonight and I’m not trying to put on another dolphin costume.
: Nao-chan wants to know what a “dolphin” is.
: It’s like a big fish that fucks with other fish. Also, where the hell did you get this girl and why doesn’t she know about dolphins yet?
: I’m afraid that is a question for someone much bigger than me...

$ kaori_love += 1
Kaori’s affection has increased to [kaori_love]! Which is kind of weird since you’re nowhere near her right now.
